newsitem.title: SPAIN: Argentaria outperforms after Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Argentaria outperforms after Q1 results.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Argentaria gained strongly on Wednesday, outpacing share indices after first quarter results gave a pleasant surprise, dealers said.
At 0910 GMT, Argentaria was up 110 pesetas, 1.73 pct, to 6,460. The Ibex-35 blue chip index added 0.94 pct to 5,783.95.
The banking group posted a 29.4 percent fall in net attributable profit in the first quarter, far worse than the consensus forecast for a 15.5 percent fall.
However this masked growth in ordinary and operating margins of nine percent year on year, and a rise in net interest income of 13.5 percent.
"We were expecting net profit to fall around 25 percent, but the operating performance is substantially better than forecasts," said a trader at a Spanish bank.
"These are good results," said Jose Sevilla, banking analyst at Merrill Lynch in Madrid. "It seems that the fall in operating results has come to an end.
The market was pleased that the bank's basic loan and commissions business at the top of the profit and loss account was recuperating.
"We are satisified," said Argentaria spokesman Manuel Bueno. "The top part shows that we are doing fine."
